Hi Diego,

Thanks for the renewal rundown last week. Procurement has issued PO #789 (attached) and Finance is ready to accept the final invoice, but they need:

- A single consolidated invoice referencing PO 789
- Evidence of Redwood's VAT treatment / EU residency for VAT purposes (we need this for our AP team)
- Wire instructions and whether SEPA is accepted (we prefer SEPA for euros)

Can you confirm you can deliver an invoice that references the PO and provide VAT residency evidence today? We'd like to schedule payment next week (target 2027-05-24).

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Procurement
Greenleaf Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal billing closeout: invoice, PO and VAT residency

Thanks Samantha — looping in Naomi (tax) and Lauren (receivables).

Naomi / Lauren: attached is the draft final invoice for the renewal (Inv-RED-202705-001). Please review and confirm:

1) Does the invoice layout and reference PO 789 correctly?
2) VAT evidence: Naomi, do we have a one-page statement we can send that states Redwood's VAT treatment for this account (reverse-charge applicability or VAT registration details)? If reverse-charge applies, we should flag that on the invoice to avoid withholding.
3) Wire instructions: we typically accept SEPA for EUR — Lauren, confirm bank details and whether we require any intermediate bank labels for Greenleaf's banks in the EU.

Samantha: once internal confirms, I will publish the invoice as PDF and provide the DocuSign amendment link for the renewal addendum (minor billing clause). Targeting to close the invoice handoff today so Greenleaf can pay on 2027-05-24.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Diego / Lauren / Samantha — quick tax note: I've attached our VAT residency memo and the one-page summary we send to customers. Key points:

- Redwood is VAT-registered in Ireland (VAT ID: IE1234567A).
- For EU B2B transactions with a valid customer VAT ID, the reverse-charge mechanism applies; customer is liable for VAT in their jurisdiction.
- If Greenleaf cannot provide a valid VAT ID (or is non-EU), we will apply Irish VAT at invoice time.

Samantha — if you can confirm Greenleaf's VAT ID (and attach to the PO/approval), we will mark the invoice as reverse-charge and include the VAT note. If you prefer, we can also provide a signed tax attestation PDF for your AP file.

Lauren — please confirm the SEPA instructions below are good to send to Greenleaf:
Bank: Redwood Inference Ltd (Bank of Ireland)
IBAN: IE29BOFI12345678901234
BIC: BOFIIE2D
Reference: Inv-RED-202705-001 / PO 789

I will follow up with a short email certifying residency if requested.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Tax Counsel
Redwood Inference

Procurement also flagged one small ask: can the invoice include the contract term dates (2027-05-01 to 2028-04-30) in the body for their GL mapping? If possible, include the contract ID: GL-CTR-3344.

We are good to schedule a SEPA transfer for 2027-05-24 provided the final invoice PDF and the DocuSign amendment link are sent today.

Best,
Samantha
